title: Kane-Mele model: bands and spin Hall conductivity
summary: The Kane-Mele model (t = 1 eV, intrinsic spin-orbit 0.1 eV): the band structure, the DOS and the spin Hall conductivity sigma^z_xy of the quantum spin Hall phase, quantized in the gap, with its spin Berry curvature map. No DFT run; seconds.
